python3 -c "
import math

# Values from the Treasury Survey of Ownership, February 28, 1982
commercial_banks = 77688  # in millions
mutual_savings_banks = 4206  # in millions

# Calculate the ratio
ratio = commercial_banks / mutual_savings_banks
print(f'Commercial banks: {commercial_banks}')
print(f'Mutual savings banks: {mutual_savings_banks}')
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')

# Calculate the natural logarithm
ln_ratio = math.log(ratio)
print(f'Natural log of ratio: {ln_ratio}')

# Round to nearest thousandths place
ln_ratio_rounded = round(ln_ratio, 3)
print(f'Result rounded to 3 decimal places: {ln_ratio_rounded}')
"
